name: When is the best time of year to start a room expansion project in the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a room expansion project in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: While room expansion projects can occur year-round, many homeowners prefer to start in late spring or early summer. This allows for foundation work and exterior framing to be completed during drier, milder weather, which can prevent delays. However, interior work can progress efficiently regardless of the season. Planning ahead is key, as design and permitting phases often take several months before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Late spring or early summer is often preferred for room expansions to capitalize on drier weather for exterior work.
